text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Trainer.
Didn't expect to run into you this early.
choice_data_list: Were you able to get some rest yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, don't worry.
My head's as clear as ever."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Though honestly, one day of peace is plenty for me.
I've got no use for an unstimulating everyday life.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa flashed her usual grin.
It seemed she had gotten a decent amount of rest.
